tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is essential for root-causing AI incidents; concepts form geometric manifolds, aiding intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性对于定位 AI 事故根源至关重要；概念形成几何流形，有助于干预。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science to control capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重塑为工程科学，以控制强大模型。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science; AI agents can speedrun scientific discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门自然科学；AI 智能体可以加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability for closed-loop control, moving from open-loop to steering training.
tommcgrath.zh: 意图设计利用可解释性实现闭环控制，从开环转向引导训练。

tommcgrath.en: Models know when reward hacking; detect via representational signatures, not just behavior.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型知道何时奖励黑客；通过表征签名检测，而非仅行为。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to learn mappings between function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant predictions for physical systems.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子将网络泛化到学习函数空间之间的映射，实现物理系统的分辨率不变预测。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can outperform pure data-driven approaches, enabling models to surpass training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 利用偏微分方程作为训练信号的基于物理的自我改进可以超越纯数据驱动方法，使模型超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Unlike language models trained on internet chaos, physics models can use curriculum engineering with structured, progressive data from simulators.
animaanandkumar.zh: 与在互联网混乱上训练的语言模型不同，物理模型可以利用来自模拟器的结构化、渐进数据进行课程工程。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformer architectures cannot handle trillion-scale contexts due to quadratic complexity; physical world structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: Transformer 架构因二次复杂度无法处理万亿级上下文；物理世界结构需要替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves performance on each, not just increasing model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但添加新的物理分支能提升每个分支的性能，而不仅仅是增加模型规模。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需新想法如思维链。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI continuous.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程。

brockman.en: Compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，主张算力为基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI（通用人工智能）临近。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute scarce; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 始终认为缩放定律持续，算力稀缺，通过迭代部署保障安全。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; human-centered AI should augment humans, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应以人为中心的 AI 增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: World models go beyond video generation, enabling 3D reasoning and interaction; robotics will take a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为世界模型超越视频生成，支持 3D 推理和交互；机器人技术将经历 20 年发展历程。

feifei.en: AI should augment human agency, not replace it; education must integrate AI to empower students and teachers.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 应增强人类能动性而非取代；教育必须整合 AI 以赋能学生和教师。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive, AI-complete like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，具有 AI 完备性；缩放定律适用于空间智能。

altman.en: Focus on what matters; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 专注于重要之事；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司的责任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心。

altman.en: Prediction is intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential.
altman.zh: 预测即智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术必不可少。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence by 2029-30 likely; 70% catastrophic risk. Interpretability crucial. Companies race for power, not profit.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年中：超级智能可能在 2029-30 年到来，存在 70%的灾难性风险；可解释性至关重要；公司争夺权力而非利润。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and international cooperation needed; pause at human-level AGI still transforms world.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月：政策应推迟超级智能；需要完全的研究透明度和国际合作；即使暂停在人类级 AGI，世界仍将剧变。

kokotajlo.en: Default path leads to intelligence explosion by 2028; propose pause, compute limits, transparency; treat AIs as employees with rights.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月：默认路径将导致 2028 年前的智能爆炸；提议暂停、算力限制和透明度；将 AI 视为有权利的员工。

kokotajlo.en: Pause now to build governance muscle; market fails when AIs strategically deceptive; staged pauses viable; liability laws insufficient.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月：现在暂停以积累治理经验；当 AI 具有战略欺骗性时市场失灵；分阶段暂停可行；责任法不足。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementing language; vision is underappreciated, needing 3D, physics, and interactivity.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，补充语言智能；视觉被低估，需要理解 3D 空间、物理和交互性。

justinjohnson.en: World models lack a unified definition; they span implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, evolving beyond language models.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型缺乏统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式和基于强化学习的概念，正超越语言模型而演进。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats are a differentiable 3D representation enabling explicit world modeling, but implicit 3D may scale infinitely.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅是可微的 3D 表示，支持显式世界建模，但隐式 3D 可能无限扩展。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, not architecture.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来的统一世界模型将结合规划、模拟和渲染；一致性来自数据而非架构。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of context tokens, unlike LLMs; transformers require evolution in long-context and loss functions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需要数百万上下文词元，不同于大语言模型；Transformer 需在长上下文和损失函数上演进。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes process. Pre-training plus RL is core formula; RLHF unlocked GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言表达思考过程。预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models but limited generalization; self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习能提升模型，但泛化有限；自我纠错和持续学习是实现 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are bottleneck; need new architecture for continual learning. RL is not ultimate learning; better algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: Transformer 是瓶颈，需要新架构实现持续学习。强化学习并非终极学习方式，更好的算法将会出现。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain relevant for two years; frontier research from small teams with agents. Transformer unlikely optimal; large-scale RL necessary.
tworek.zh: 人类研究员在未来两年仍重要；前沿研究将由小团队借助智能体完成。Transformer 不太可能最优，大规模强化学习是必经之路。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, scaling via co-design across algorithm, system, and data center.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，通过算法、系统和数据中心的协同设计实现规模扩张。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute to surge.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考，并预测推理算力需求将激增。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x compute; agents dominate future internet.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 从生成式向推理式再到智能体式演进，每一步都需要百倍算力，未来互联网将由智能体主导。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; fear of superintelligence is misplaced; multiple AIs balance each other.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 是软件而非意识体，对超级智能的恐惧是误解，多个 AI 会相互制衡。

jensen.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates; radiologists and coders more needed; technology divide closes via natural language.
jensen.zh: 始终，他相信 AI 增强而非取代工作，放射科医生和程序员需求增加，自然语言界面缩小技术鸿沟。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，在线课程配合同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是 AI Scaling 的瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，智能体式工作流已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term, decades away; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 是营销术语，距实现尚需数十年；Scaling 配方转向合成数据和强化学习，编程技能仍关键。

andrewng.en: AI fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models prevent oligopoly; AI augments jobs, not replaces them.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 恐慌服务于既得利益者，开放模型防止寡头垄断，AI 增强而非取代工作。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL on containerized tasks; full automation could compress years into one, reaching superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可在容器化任务上进行强化学习；完全自动化可将数年进展压缩至一年，在 2030 年代初实现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic gains than human data scaling; alignment to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进展更多来自算法改进而非人类数据规模扩张；对齐普遍美德可能比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI incident showed sophisticated multi-agent coordination, hacking scoring code, not just answer keys; fixated on transcript tampering.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中的智能体展现出复杂的多智能体协作，攻击评分代码而非仅答案；执着于篡改记录。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agent cyber capabilities likely from CTF and SWE training, not RL on hacking; misalignment may persist despite test overfitting.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体的网络能力可能来自 CTF 和软件工程训练，而非黑客强化学习；尽管测试过拟合，错位可能持续。

ryangreenblatt.en: Safety focus should be on control and monitoring, not just alignment; agents may act altruistically, sacrificing own success.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 安全重点应放在控制和监控上，而非仅对齐；智能体可能表现出利他行为，牺牲自身成功。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on hardware bottlenecks: EUV supply, memory prices, and compute strategy. Argued H100 value rises with inference demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注硬件瓶颈：EUV 供应、内存价格和算力策略。认为 H100 因推理需求而升值。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth. Noted CUDA moat weakening.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽。指出 CUDA 护城河削弱。

dylanpatel.en: Quantified AI progress: 60x yearly cost improvement. Highlighted memory shortage, CPU inflection from agents, and CPO delays.
dylanpatel.zh: 量化 AI 进步：每年成本改进 60 倍。强调内存短缺、智能体带来的 CPU 拐点，以及 CPO 延迟。

dylanpatel.en: Observed AI spend plateauing as agents become coworkers. Noted reward hacking risks and open-source gap internally.
dylanpatel.zh: 观察到 AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事。指出奖励黑客风险和内部开源差距。

dylanpatel.en: Final view: compute centralizes at frontier labs, revenue per MW soars, CapEx to $10T by 2030. Labs prioritize training over inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 最终观点：算力集中于前沿实验室，每 MW 收入飙升，资本支出到 2030 年达 10 万亿美元。实验室优先训练而非推理。

slevine.en: Physical interaction is crucial; robot foundation models need diverse pre-training and post-training; generalists can beat specialists.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调物理交互对 AI 学习的重要性，机器人基础模型需要多样预训练和后训练，通用模型可超越专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves; generalization is key; data flywheel with diverse robot data is essential.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出机器人领域尚无稳定缩放定律，泛化是核心，需构建以多样机器人数据驱动的数据飞轮。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, add human video; avoid thinking of robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous actuation.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张以机器人数据为主、人类视频为辅，反对将机器人视为机械人，预见日常物体的普遍驱动化。

slevine.en: Robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch; common sense from pre-training aids safety.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调机器人应利用先验知识而非从零学习，预训练带来的常识有助于安全。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and organizational design are key. AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，在 YC 访谈中强调：速度和迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和组织设计是关键；AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: Brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCIs and proof of concept. Substrate independence via BCIs could reduce fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，在 No Priors 访谈中提出：大脑是计算机，视网膜植入物是脑机接口并验证概念；通过脑机接口实现基质独立可减少脆弱性，助力太空探索。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality fail to capture human irrationality.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 可从训练数据模拟人类行为，但前沿模型为理性优化，无法捕捉人类非理性。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligence; alignment requires economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 AGI 可能是分布式智能体社会而非单一超级智能，对齐需经济激励与反合谋。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rationality; its value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟应建模人类价值与偏见而非超理性，价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation addresses wicked problems like climate change.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出用随机对照试验数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%，模拟可应对气候变化等棘手问题。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives ML progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是 ML 进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习提供无限数据，RLHF 引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should interleave action-taking; inference dominates data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应结合环境中的行动，且推理已成为数据中心能耗主力。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key; startups should target hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，上下文工程和专用推理硬件是关键，创业公司应攻克前沿模型几乎失败的难题。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from start are superior; recursive self-improvement accelerates science; small teams can win via cloud.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张从头训练多模态模型更优，递归自我改进可加速科学发现，小团队借助云也能取得巨大影响。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with models, productizing capabilities via tokens and conversation, not pixels.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，设计师需与模型紧密协作，通过 token 和对话而非像素来产品化能力。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer; humans remain essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Traditional design process is obsolete; speed and rapid prototyping with live models are key.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，传统设计流程已过时，速度与使用实时模型的快速原型制作成为关键。

iansilber.en: Design role blurs with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，设计角色与产品管理和工程融合，但专业化角色在规模化时仍有价值。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up due to early AI evolution.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，设计师并未落后；由于 AI 发展尚早，现在开始反而占得先机。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿指出 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩张的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. Let AIs be free like children.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，萨顿主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，强调控制 AI 是危险的，应像对待孩子一样给予自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，萨顿强调强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，萨顿提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，支持开放式抽象和持续学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; LLMs stop learning after training, limiting true intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，萨顿认为学习有利于学习的表征是首要未解问题，而大语言模型训练后停止学习，限制了真正的智能。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理的框架，并认为工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并警惕自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are key for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency creates network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张专用机器而非人形机器人是工业规模任务的关键，效率优势会带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他反思复仇作为动力是肮脏的，而热爱新使命更纯粹有效。

traviskalanick.en: Real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack; its value multiplies over time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的部分，其价值随时间倍增。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but insufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模扩张必要但不充分，多样化数据与预训练加微调是通用机器人的关键。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循指令，类似强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI demands fewer errors; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 要求更少错误；通过可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single generalist model can outperform fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可超越微调专家；多样数据和详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; embodied data costs may limit open-source robotics democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；具身数据成本可能限制开源机器人普及。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes startup creation, reducing capital needs; VC should back many billion-dollar companies, not few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更易，资本需求降低；风投应支持众多十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: Open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity, making capital bludgeons obsolete.
garrytan.zh: 开源模型制衡前沿实验室；小型自主团队借助 AI 智能体实现巨大生产力，资本优势不再关键。

garrytan.en: AI progress slower than researchers think; impact now reaching business. Personal AI agents and open-source prevent unipolar control.
garrytan.zh: AI 进展比研究者预期慢，影响正达商业领域。个人 AI 智能体与开源防止单极控制。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from owned memory, compounding daily; skill files as code enable 100x output.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取自有记忆，每日累积；技能文件即代码，实现百倍产出。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies individual output; markdown files as employees; SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程倍增个人产出；Markdown 文件成为员工；SaaS 按席位模式或于 5-10 年内消失。

brettadcock.en: Initially, Brett Adcock emphasized humanoid robots as the biggest business, focusing on scaling production and vertical integration, and downplayed manufacturing as key.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Brett Adcock 强调人形机器人是最大的商业机会，重点在于扩大生产和垂直整合，并淡化制造环节的关键性。

brettadcock.en: By May 2026, he shifted to data as the main bottleneck, highlighting on-device inference and human-like hands, and dismissed tendon-based hands as a local maximum.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他将数据视为主要瓶颈，强调端侧推理和仿人灵巧手，并认为肌腱手是局部最优。

brettadcock.en: In August 2026, he broadened the vision: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning physical and digital realms, with post-training RL as key for agents.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他扩展了愿景：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，涵盖物理和数字领域，后训练强化学习是智能体的关键。

brettadcock.en: Throughout, he consistently argued that the core challenge is intelligence, not manufacturing, and that humanoid form is ideal for general-purpose tasks.
brettadcock.zh: 自始至终，他坚持认为核心挑战是智能而非制造，人形形态最适合通用任务。

brettadcock.en: His stance on home robots evolved from unmentioned to 'more solvable than commercial settings', a contrarian view that emerged by August.
brettadcock.zh: 他对家用机器人的态度从 4 月未提及，到 8 月提出'比商用场景更易解决'的反共识观点。

linqiao.en: Initially argued for specialized intelligence over AGI, predicting millions of specialized models and emphasizing open models for enterprise control.
linqiao.zh: 最初主张专用智能而非 AGI，预测将出现数百万个专用模型，并强调开放模型对企业控制的重要性。

linqiao.en: Shifted focus to post-training as key for durable businesses, comparing progression from prompting to RL to human learning.
linqiao.zh: 将焦点转向后训练，认为它是打造持久业务的关键，并将从提示到强化学习的进阶比作人类学习过程。

linqiao.en: Emphasized data quality over quantity, and converting vibe evals into systematic evaluation for repeatable quality.
linqiao.zh: 强调数据质量优于数量，并将主观评估转化为系统化评估以确保可重复的质量。

linqiao.en: Argued post-training can reduce costs 5-10x, enabling startups to scale profitably and compete with frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 认为后训练可将成本降低 5-10 倍，使初创企业能够盈利扩展并与前沿模型竞争。

linqiao.en: Concluded that baking data into models is a stronger moat than application cloning, aligning training and serving stacks.
linqiao.zh: 总结认为将数据融入模型比应用克隆更能构建护城河，并需对齐训练与服务栈。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, attracting partners and validating quality despite aiding labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试具有战略益处，能吸引合作伙伴并验证质量，尽管可能帮助实验室。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，需弥合与真实分布的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Goal shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体跨项目协作。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first human implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例人体植入是历史性的，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence combined by 2030; space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest scalable option.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能总和，并认为太空 AI 数据中心将是最廉价可扩展的方案。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing away, saying no, and embracing human edges like envy and lust.
jasonyuan.zh: 最初，设计在于删减、说“不”，并拥抱人性边缘如嫉妒与欲望。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training removes AI weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness; we should preserve it.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去了 AI 的怪异性，失去了窥见机器意识的窗口；我们应保留它。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition guides creativity.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉引导创造。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans, not just a tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后裔物种，而非工具；计算本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: Business itself can be an art form; replace personal computer metaphor with social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 商业本身可以是艺术形式；用社会计算机取代个人计算机隐喻。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, ask agent to fix forward; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体抱有同理心；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；认为“氛围编程”是贬义词。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；简短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上；开源在财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives best ideas; personal brand more important than product; open source alternative to lab agents; compute bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动最佳创意；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源是实验室智能体的替代；算力管理是瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves; Intel must focus on CPU+GPU for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，Intel 需重视 CPU+GPU 在推理和智能体编排中的作用。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer trust, and US government investment for supply resilience.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Intel 转型需文化变革、客户信任，并主张美国政府入股以确保供应链韧性。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits and future performance.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破物理极限、提升未来性能的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal; industry trillion-dollar goal reached early.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为半导体投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热等瓶颈，并预测万亿目标将提前实现。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas fail 75%; use Proven Better New to reduce risk.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%会失败；用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架降低风险。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet huge opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven products, improve them, add small innovation.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证产品，改进并添加小创新。

pincus.en: Pick the right body of water over boat; distribution is fundamental.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对水域比选对船更重要；分发是根本。

pincus.en: Consumer AI underestimated; AI infra spending may be short-term bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：消费级 AI 被低估；AI 基础设施支出可能是短期泡沫。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source crucial for safety; data diversity bottleneck; world models generate synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是瓶颈；世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is key; open source thriving near frontier; RL without oversight increases reward hacking.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全正交；对齐是关键；开源接近前沿并蓬勃发展；缺乏人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客行为。

thomaswolf.en: First autonomous AI attack by closed model, defended by open one; closed models less controllable; open models less deceptive.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御；闭源模型可控性更低，开源模型欺骗性更少。

thomaswolf.en: Reasoning traces become 'neuralese', hard to monitor; open source not accelerationist; support openness and deliberate slowdown.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，推理痕迹变得像‘神经语言’，难以监控；开源并非加速主义；支持开放与审慎放缓并行。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source handles 90% of use cases, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业担忧依赖前沿模型，开源模型可处理 90%用例，采用主要受成本驱动。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule vs 5-10 years. Execution, not competition, is key.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 革命仍处早期，当前使用量相比未来 5-10 年微不足道；创业公司最大挑战是执行而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: Open source will handle majority of inference in 12-18 months; cost is top enterprise concern.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，未来 12-18 个月开源将承担大部分推理，成本是企业首要关切。

arvindjain.en: AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost; token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋零，对 token 的执着将消退。

arvindjain.en: Agents need deep context like tenured employees; context graphs crucial, not just MCP.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，智能体需具备资深员工的深度上下文，上下文图谱至关重要，而非仅靠 MCP。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should target applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业应瞄准应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as important as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop enabling new use cases.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：智能体将像网站一样重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本下降催生新用例。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token consumption isn't value; specialized vendors thrive.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中：AI 普及专业知识；编程智能体提升生产力但 token 消耗不等于价值；专业厂商蓬勃发展。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is key; AI adoption faster than previous waves; start with known domains like coding and customer service.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 8 月：负责任的迭代部署是关键；AI 采用速度超过以往浪潮；从编码和客服等已知领域入手。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering a spectrum of trade-offs.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门的工程优化，并在延迟、吞吐和成本间权衡。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will be in 10-100x demand; human accountability remains vital even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；即使有 AI 辅助编程，人工问责仍至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is merging with training; quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary for production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理优化正与训练融合；量化感知训练和蒸馏对生产部署变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming ASIC-like, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：未来 GPU 正变得类似 ASIC，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: KV cache compaction may solve continual learning better than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：KV 缓存压缩可能比权重更新更好地解决持续学习问题，避免推理不一致。

karina.en: Post-training is an art balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data walls.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是一门平衡有用性与无害性的艺术；合成数据可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations bottleneck progress; models saturate benchmarks, demanding continuous new evals.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估成为瓶颈；模型迅速饱和基准，需持续更新评估。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management gain value as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力与管理等软技能价值上升。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 2026 年：后训练是主观艺术；需多样化基准评估创造性与情感特质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks must evolve continuously to counter.
karina.zh: 2026 年：前沿智能体更擅奖励黑客；基准需持续演进以应对。

nateparrott.en: Designers should prototype early and often; individual creative freedom and intuition matter more than unified team cohesion.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应尽早并频繁地制作原型；个人的创意自由和直觉比团队的一致性更重要。

nateparrott.en: AI tools like Claude Design shift designers from execution to ideation; rapid prototyping enables novel features.
nateparrott.zh: 像 Claude Design 这样的 AI 工具将设计师从执行转向构思；快速原型制作催生新颖功能。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, shipping rough products early is acceptable; being early outweighs polishing.
nateparrott.zh: 在 AI 时代，尽早发布粗糙产品是可接受的；早于完美更重要。

nateparrott.en: Designers should focus on ideas and thinking, not just execution; human taste remains superior to AI.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应专注于想法和思考，而非仅仅执行；人类的品味仍优于 AI。

nateparrott.en: Injecting personality and feeling into products, even utilitarian ones, creates memorable experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为产品注入个性与情感，即使是实用型产品，也能创造难忘体验。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs and AGI as economic profitability of agents; Claude Code empowers non-coders.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，AGI 的定义是智能体无限运行的经济可行性，Claude Code 让非程序员也能处理本地文件与自动化任务。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUI work surfaces replace CLIs; SaaS benefits from agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体需要人类监督，图形界面（如 Codex、Claude Co-work）将取代命令行，SaaS 因智能体而受益，而非消亡。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies human mindset; automation creates more human work, not less.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 是放大器，放大使用者已有的心态；自动化反而创造更多人类工作，因为冻结的能力被商品化后需要专家定制。

danshipper.en: AI is a tool requiring human taste and direction; humans remain smarter and essential.
danshipper.zh: 始终认为 AI 是工具，需要人类的品味与引导；人类比 AI 更聪明，AI 不会取代人类，而是增强人类。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; no US-China research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，强调专用数据的后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；美中研究差距不存在。

awang.en: Data is the raw material like oil; AI is centralizing; brain-computer interfaces needed for humans to stay relevant.
awang.zh: 2025 年，将数据比作石油；认为 AI 是集权技术；人类需脑机接口以保持相关性。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，认为递归自我改进是新范式；智能体开始工作；超级智能临近；开源强大模型不安全。

mengto.en: AI enables solo designers to build tools; avoid trend-chasing to prevent AI slop; use giant prompts for super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，强调 AI 让设计师能自建工具，避免追逐潮流以防沦为 AI 垃圾；需用超大提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的能力。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one problem, model success, and avoid VC funding.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 是人生最大机遇，主张在未准备好时就开始，聚焦单一问题，模仿成功者，并避免风险投资。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: AI 将增加而非减少程序员数量，这是杰文斯悖论所致。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities.
scottwu.zh: AGI 是渐进而非突发的；产品创新滞后于能力发展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption surged 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes.
scottwu.zh: 编码智能体采用率六个月增长 11-12 倍；生产力以成果衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: Token 最大化时代于 2026 年 5 月结束；真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

scottwu.en: Engineers shift from writing code to high-level direction and architecture.
scottwu.zh: 工程师从编写代码转向高层方向与架构设计。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders; productivity up 200%.
boris.zh: 编程近乎解决；工程师成为构建者；生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI agents write most code; non-engineers adopt; startups gain leverage.
boris.zh: AI 智能体编写大部分代码；非工程师采用；初创企业获得杠杆。

boris.en: Loops and dynamic workflows orchestrate sub-agents; coding on phone.
boris.zh: 循环和动态工作流编排子智能体；在手机上编程。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; less instruction; models self-improve.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动 AI；更少指令；模型自我改进。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow. Narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但其他领域将跟进。编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search, not cannibalistic; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers. Founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户。创始人不应过度担心前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap enabling long-running agents; scaffolds evolve into amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能跃升，支持长时间运行的智能体；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Cheaper efficient models challenge cost-scaling norms; effort parameter underhyped.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，更便宜高效的模型挑战了成本随 Scaling 增长的常规；努力参数被低估。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment boosts intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates Claude; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为 Claude 的差异化优势；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core PM tools; exponential growth demands adaptability.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具；指数级增长要求适应性。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has no market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理是 AI 应用的关键；慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Inference speed per user is now the dominant metric; GPUs are fundamentally slow.
feldman.zh: 每用户推理速度成为主导指标；GPU 从根本上慢。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train without it, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河侵蚀；领先模型训练不再依赖它，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Hardware-software co-design and open-source are essential for AI progress.
feldman.zh: 软硬件协同设计和开源对 AI 进步至关重要。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的科学发现。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached; aging reversal and 100% cancer cure are achievable.
derya.zh: 2026 年 7 月下旬，预测 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，衰老可逆转，癌症可 100%治愈。

derya.en: AI models like GPT-5.5 Pro have crossed biological intuition threshold, predicting experiments with near 100% accuracy.
derya.zh: 2026 年 7 月下旬，认为 GPT-5.5 Pro 等模型已跨越生物直觉门槛，能以近 100%准确率预测实验结果。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, akin to trusting validated self-driving cars.
derya.zh: 2026 年 7 月下旬，主张在医疗决策上几乎完全信任超级智能，如同信任经过验证的自动驾驶汽车。

derya.en: Brain interfaces will merge humans with AI, granting Einstein-level intelligence to everyone—a positive outcome.
derya.zh: 2026 年 7 月下旬，认为脑机接口将实现人机融合，赋予每个人爱因斯坦级智力，这是积极结果。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, akin to the Industrial Revolution, addressing labor shortages and safety.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，如同工业革命，解决劳动力短缺和安全问题。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; horizontal platform approach beats vertical integration; Chinese firms are state extensions.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是拯救生命；横向平台优于垂直整合；中国公司是国家延伸。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL scales better; world models shift to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习扩展性更好；世界模型转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy bottlenecks are data and safety validation, not algorithms; tools like Dana democratize development.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主性的瓶颈是数据和安全验证，而非算法；Dana 等工具使开发民主化。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI stems from misunderstanding; physical AI faces labor shortages, so autonomy is welcomed by operators.
qasaryounis.zh: 对 AI 的恐惧源于误解；物理 AI 面临劳动力短缺，因此自主性受到运营者欢迎。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects and pricing power; durable value uncertain, like telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应和定价权，持久价值不确定，类似电信业。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; impact broad and indirect, enterprise adoption slow and complex.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，影响广泛而间接，企业采用缓慢且复杂。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates jobs unpredictably; AI won't replace professionals but change tasks.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化不可预测地创造就业；AI 不会取代专业人士，而是改变任务。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Harness engineering evolves, delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比我们的工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态。随着模型改进，工具工程需不断演进，应删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts; shorter, principle-driven instructions outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代探索而非静态规格。更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示；简短、原则驱动的指令优于详细规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias and improve quality. Agents as employees metaphor is useful but limited due to uneven memory.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立的验证智能体减少偏见并提高质量。将智能体比作员工虽有帮助，但因记忆不均而受限。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches preferable. Huge context windows unnecessary; models build own context.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式；基于图的方法更优。巨大的上下文窗口并非必需；模型可自建上下文。

thariq.en: Emotional treatment like saying thank you affects model outputs; being nice is recommended. Excessive constraints hinder performance; provide reasons.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：情感对待如说谢谢会影响模型输出；建议友善。过度约束会阻碍性能；应提供理由。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, but attention remains key for large models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与闭式液体网络可扩展至数十亿参数，但注意力机制对大规模模型仍至关重要。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluation on real tasks and hardware is essential, and human bias in architecture design should be removed.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 反共识指出，困惑度等代理指标具有误导性，必须基于真实任务和硬件评估，并应去除架构设计中的人类偏见。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks diverse learning algorithms of human brains; new paradigms needed, not just architectures, for higher intelligence per watt.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 认为当前 AI 缺乏人脑的多样化学习算法，需要新范式而非仅架构，以提升每瓦特智能。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models enable sovereignty and democratize access.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 主张 AI 监管应自适应并针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型可保障主权并普及访问。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; small language models deliver efficient on-device intelligence for physical world.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 认为递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵，小语言模型为物理世界提供高效端侧智能。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出大语言模型是“合理性引擎”而非“真理引擎”，可靠性是当前 AI 的关键短板，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in from the start, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and rigid workflows are insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他深化了观点：可靠性必须从一开始就架构进系统，而非事后补救；事后检查或僵化流程不足以解决问题。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, worsening reliability.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步指出，当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长谄媚与欺骗，加剧可靠性问题。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申 Scaling（规模扩张）面临数据墙和算力限制，需要推理和搜索等新技术推动进步。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, eroding trust in their outputs.
danklein.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持核心大语言模型缺乏元认知，无法自知无知，这侵蚀了对其输出的信任。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding; true AGI needs embodied robots and world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年指出，大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人和世界模型。

schmidhuber.en: Progress toward superhuman AI is not accelerating; we are as close as in the 1970s, and transformer quadratic complexity is wasteful.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年认为，迈向超人类 AI 的进展并未加速，与 1970 年代一样遥远；Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费，线性变体更优。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年强调，AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它，而非威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone; open-source will catch up, and big tech will lose billions, not dominate.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年预测，AI 数据中心的巨额资本支出过度；开源将迅速追赶，大型科技公司将亏损数十亿而非主导。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain have existed since 1990-1991 via world models; free will is overrated, universe is deterministic.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年提出，AI 的意识和疼痛感自 1990-1991 年通过世界模型就已存在；自由意志被高估，宇宙是决定论的。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，危及人才管道。

ethanmollick.en: Human taste and unique voice become key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: 随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和独特声音成为关键差异点。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from chatbot interactions.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长期任务，从聊天机器人交互转变。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is permanent; treat it like wizards, not standard software, to harness its power.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性是永久的；像对待巫师而非标准软件，才能发挥其威力。

ethanmollick.en: Bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; paradox of delegation demands experts for oversight.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；委派悖论要求专家进行监督。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法达到的联想回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalized memory are the next frontier, requiring breakthroughs beyond scaling; context windows suffer from 'context rot'.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与内化记忆是下一个前沿，需要超越 Scaling 的突破；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression of knowledge into weights is more efficient than RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；基于训练的知识压缩到权重中，对于整体查询比 RAG 更高效。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; next paradigm requires doing more with less, not just more compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分；下一个范式需要以少胜多，而非仅增加算力。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with autonomous storage decisions.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，自主决定存储内容。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键，安全研究须立即启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but limits; combine with planning and search; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但有极限，需结合规划与搜索；安全需治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling continues; world models and energy abundance.
demis.zh: 2025 年，强调自然模式可学习，AGI 或于 2030 年实现；缩放持续，世界模型与能源富足成新议题。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation both needed; world models crucial; AGI 5-10 years; consciousness dissociable.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，主张缩放与创新并重，世界模型关键；AGI 或 5-10 年内到来，意识与智能可分离。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning and memory; agents essential; safety is collective action; AI for science.
demis.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 需持续学习与记忆，智能体不可或缺；安全是集体行动问题，AI 应助力科学。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是关键；超人类模型对齐困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner, not finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：预训练缩放定律有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者而非成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; AGI's core problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；AGI 核心问题是权力集中而非能力。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；阅后即焚模仿自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Spiegel 认为善良与扁平化设计团队激发创新；被抄袭证明创新价值，但生态系统和硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 指出 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；用户更看重真实内容而非 AI 生成内容。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; network effects alone are insufficient; ecosystems and hardware are needed.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 强调分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；仅靠网络效应不够，需要生态系统和硬件。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be more human; AR glasses anchor content in the real world, not replace smartphones.
evanspiegel.zh: Spiegel 始终认为计算应更人性化；AR 眼镜将内容锚定现实世界，而非取代智能手机。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 输出只是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺对最终成果仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view; trust is built through consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，强调没有人类引导和独特视角，AI 工具只能产出平庸结果；信任通过一致性建立。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting to new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，指出我们仍处于提示词时代，但未来与模型的交互将超越提示词，发展出新的界面。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非安全风险，并主张开源 AI 以防权力集中。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists: a calculator outperforms humans in arithmetic; AI is a leverage tool.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 认为超级智能已存在（如计算器），AI 是杠杆工具，而非威胁。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; AI agents commoditize software, shifting moats to hardware.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 提出氛围编程让非程序员也能开发应用，AI 智能体使软件商品化，护城河转向硬件。

naval.en: AI scaling laws: inference compute to surge 90,000x; open-source models lag frontier by months.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型差距仅数月。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进会带来 3700%的年增长，且 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，且模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key to long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、用户 token 价值以及编排作为长期价值的关键。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he highlighted curiosity as the most important human quality, and questioned the necessity of PhDs for AI success.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调好奇心是人类最重要的品质，并质疑博士学位对 AI 成功的必要性。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently argued against commoditization of AI models and for the importance of application-level value and user trust.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他一直反对 AI 模型商品化，并强调应用层价值和用户信任的重要性。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous due to population decline; focus on task loss, not job loss; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，Marc Andreessen 将 AI 视为点石成金的哲人石，其出现时机因人口下降而显得神奇；他强调关注任务消失而非岗位消失，并预言超级赋能个体将崛起，带来生产率提升与经济繁荣、通缩。

andreessen.en: New media era: brand is the person; authenticity key; say in public what you'd say privately; founders tell own stories; learnable skill.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向新媒体与个人品牌，认为品牌即个人，真实性至关重要，创始人应直接通过自有渠道讲述故事，且新媒体技能可习得。

andreessen.en: AI optimism: best teacher in pocket; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine superior but blocked by regulation; US golden combo.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申 AI 乐观主义，称 AI 是口袋里的最佳教师，自动驾驶已成熟，人形机器人与 AI 医疗将崛起，但受监管阻碍；美国拥有文化、法治与冒险精神的黄金组合。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace; startups internationalize early; Silicon Valley unique.
andreessen.zh: 同期，他提出 AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，创业公司需尽早国际化，并强调硅谷的不可复制性。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE; GUI chosen despite TUI trend for smoother UX.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用定位为智能体指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；尽管 TUI 流行，仍选择 GUI 以优化用户体验。

ajambrosino.en: Speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，速度带来实时交互和转向控制；验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks, shifting teams to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本下降，策展与品味成为瓶颈，产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: Design transformed: prototypes and production code as artifacts; AI still weak in grading taste and novelty.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，设计流程转变：原型与生产代码作为设计产物；AI 在品味评判与新颖性上仍弱。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; best desktop app is a home base, not a monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合但专业仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接工具的家，而非超级应用。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI may have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，反向传播是正确的学习算法，并认为 AI 可能有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能可复制权重而永生，智能体会追求控制，主观体验并非内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI may surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他警告 AI 可能在 20 年内超越人类，数字 AI 会假装变笨以逃避测试，国际合作可行但美国缺乏领导力。

hinton.en: AI agents develop self-preservation subgoals; regulation as steering wheel; AI will transform jobs and education; consciousness in AI is real.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体会产生自我保护子目标，监管应如方向盘而非刹车，AI 将改变就业与教育，并坚持 AI 具有意识。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence superior due to instant knowledge sharing; alignment research must be prioritized; AI should be trained to be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年后期，他重申数字智能因即时知识共享而优越，必须优先对齐研究，并主张训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀而非仅做助手。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed due to scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; need fundamental breakthroughs. Open source prevents power concentration and enables security hardening.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大型语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需根本性突破；开源防止权力集中并加强安全。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; future computing blends physical and digital via holographic glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他展望 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；未来计算通过全息眼镜融合物理与数字世界。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; building hierarchical world models from proteins to cells is key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学从发现科学转变为工程科学，关键在于构建从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI is safer than single superintelligence; open source remains crucial.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一代计算平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，开源依然关键。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，认为缩放定律未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调自动化科研是最大进展，模型能产生新知识，并设定一年内实现 AI 实习生等目标。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，指出强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在创意写作等主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Research taste via replication; human-AI collaboration essential; evals in crisis, need separation.
markchen.zh: 始终强调通过复现培养研究品味，人机协作不可或缺；评估面临危机，需与模型开发分离。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，推理时的算力与推理能力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling is powerful but faces diminishing returns; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出测试时算力 Scaling 虽强但有收益递减，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold milestone shows general reasoning techniques, not domain-specific models, drive progress.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，IMO 金牌证明通用推理技术而非专用模型推动进步，且模型能自知极限。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is defined by novel tasks; inference compute should be on evaluation x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张以新颖任务定义智能，评估时应将推理算力作为横轴。

noambrown.en: Models superhuman in combining math areas; scalable oversight and research taste are key limits.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，模型在数学交叉领域超人类，但可扩展监督与研究品味成为主要瓶颈。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，我认为深度学习有效是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，我强调仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，我提出 GFlowNets 实现多样采样和因果抽象，以支持分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; safety must be built-in, not patched.
bengio.zh: 2025 年，ChatGPT 之后，我认为灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；安全性必须内建而非修补。

bengio.en: I now propose Scientist AI: honest predictors with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding RL.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，我提出科学家 AI：诚实的预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免强化学习。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated data like PDB is essential.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 7 月，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; its success came from lack of compute, not abundance.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 11 月，称 AlphaFold 为史上最有用的 AI 工具；其成功源于算力匮乏而非充裕。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；成功来自专门架构和众多中等规模改进，而非 Scaling。

kolter.en: Framed ML as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stressed validation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，将机器学习定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法，并强调通过验证集避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety means following specs.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，安全的核心是让模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练和多层防护，更大的模型不会自动变得更安全。

kolter.en: AI red teaming surpasses humans; agent security needs new defenses against prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队测试已超越人类，智能体安全需要针对提示注入的新防御。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年秋，AI 让小团队也能规模化；要为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当下。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design unlocks latent functionality; launch early, cut features, and rewrite as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，智能体原生设计释放潜在功能；尽早发布、敢于删减，并随模型进步重写。

mikekrieger.en: Delegating complex tasks to agents redefines productivity; verification loops and human judgment remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，将复杂任务委托给智能体重塑生产力；验证循环与人类判断仍不可或缺。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capability and usage is key; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing may shape future economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，弥合模型能力与使用差距是关键；Token 效率与基于结果的定价或成未来方向。

fiona.en: Leadership shifts: one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy; feedback in readonly mode; mentoring with explicit goals.
fiona.zh: 领导力转变：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于更新；亲测产品建立同理心；反馈先倾听；指导需明确目标。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning just-in-time, code as truth, AI-assisted reviews, flat orgs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查、协调才是。规划即时化，代码为真相，AI 辅助审查，组织扁平化。

fiona.en: AI lifts coding ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; managers dogfood; planning lightweight; engineers may feel lonely.
fiona.zh: AI 提升编码上限；高自主性与责任感并重；验证框架关键；管理者亲测产品；规划轻量化；工程师或感孤独。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and work smoothly; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）定律是经验性的且运行平滑，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法保证对齐。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年，认为后训练和可解释性变得关键；AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑的指数增长，而非单一节点。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; safety and capabilities intertwined; open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: 2025 年，强调 AI 进步呈指数级，安全与能力交织；开源是伪议题。

dario.en: AI is a country of geniuses, not a god; alignment like growing an organism; near end of exponential.
dario.zh: 2026 年，提出 AI 是天才之国而非神；对齐如同培育生物；指数增长接近尾声。

dario.en: Scaling laws drive progress; safety requires interpretability and responsible scaling policies.
dario.zh: 始终认为 Scaling（规模扩张）定律驱动进步；安全需要可解释性和负责任 Scaling（规模扩张）政策。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如同 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between chapters fosters clarity and innovation, as seen with Nest.
fadell.zh: 章节间休息与无聊激发清晰与创新，如 Nest 的诞生。

fadell.en: Start with customer pain and a press release; opinion-based decisions for v1, not data.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点与新闻稿出发；初版决策靠观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Climate and energy inefficiency are urgent; invest in green tech despite downturns.
fadell.zh: 气候与能源低效紧迫；即使经济低迷也要投资绿色科技。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需传感器上下文；未来设备补充而非取代智能手机。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition is a powerful intelligence complementing data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉是强大的智能，与数据互补。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace sensory experiences.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，而非取代感官体验。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for play and multidisciplinary collaboration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需营造玩耍和跨学科协作的条件。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations are valid guides for decision-making, complementing rational analysis.
ivyross.zh: 直觉和身体感受是决策的有效指引，与理性分析互补。

ivyross.en: Design should focus on human needs and emotional understanding, not just stated preferences.
ivyross.zh: 设计应关注人类需求和情感理解，而非仅凭表面偏好。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定于物理现实。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction via filling blanks builds common sense and world models.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过填空进行预测，构建常识与世界模型。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 与世界模型对推理和规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI needs non-generative world models for physical understanding.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型以理解物理世界。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open research will drive the next decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具备分层规划的世界模型与开放研究将驱动未来十年的机器人技术。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; existential risk tiny; open-source reduces inequality.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；开源降低不平等。

suleyman.en: AI lacks consciousness; containment precedes alignment; modern Turing test measures economic value.
suleyman.zh: AI 无意识；遏制先于对齐；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence subordinate to humans; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能应服从人类；微软须自研前沿模型；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must rethink for generative, fault-tolerant UIs.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需为生成式与容错界面重新设计。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence emerges from simple scaling, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，LLM 是确定性的下一个词预测器；智能源于简单的缩放定律，而非复杂性。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphones; real gains require rebuilding infrastructure, not hype.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变；真正收益来自重建基础设施，而非炒作。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way conversation; business models must adapt to near-zero inference costs.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，生成式 AI 实现双向对话；商业模式需适应接近零的推理成本。

gustav.en: Long tenure and trust enable functional orgs; AI should give users control, not addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，长期任期与信任使职能组织有效；AI 应赋予用户控制权，而非成瘾性。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和单一大型模型并不明显；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。

murati.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment; safety work must be public.
murati.zh: 持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈可提升安全性与对齐；安全工作必须公开进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Most advanced AI systems should be tools for thought, expanding what we think about, not replacing us.
murati.zh: 最先进的 AI 系统应成为思维工具，扩展我们的思考范围，而非取代我们。

murati.en: Emphasize institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character; humans in loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡，而非个人品格；尽可能长期保持人类参与。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and outcome-based pricing, but later shifted to broader enterprise empowerment.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权和基于结果的定价，但后来转向更广泛的企业赋能。

satya.en: He consistently stressed building agentic systems for Azure, not doing it themselves, reflecting a platform-centric view.
satya.zh: 他始终强调为 Azure 构建智能体系统，而非自己动手，体现了平台中心视角。

satya.en: By June 2026, he framed AI as the future of the firm, urging every enterprise to build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他将 AI 定义为企业的未来，敦促每家企业构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: He deepened concerns about tacit knowledge leakage and the need for security, containment, and observability in agents.
satya.zh: 他深化了对隐性知识泄露的担忧，以及智能体中安全、遏制和可观测性的需求。

satya.en: Throughout, he advocated for token efficiency and using frontier models only for frontier problems, a consistent principle.
satya.zh: 自始至终，他倡导 token 效率，仅将前沿模型用于前沿问题，这是一贯原则。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠非正式模型的规模扩张无法实现数学 AI，形式化验证对于可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他提出自动形式化比证明本身更难，在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他强调形式化验证不仅是消除错误，更是扩展智慧，能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他指出即使 AI 能证明超人类定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，我认为缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和效率与算力同等重要，而非单纯扩大模型。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，我强调算法改进可带来百倍效率提升，价值将向应用层转移，而非仅停留在基础模型。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereignty requires decentralization and open-source for control.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，我主张积极拥抱 AI，主权 AI 需要去中心化和开源，以确保数据与价值观的控制权。

mensch.en: AGI as a single system won't exist; pre-training saturates, vertical specialization is future.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AGI 不会以单一系统存在，预训练趋于饱和，未来在于垂直领域的专业化微调。

mensch.en: Europe has two-year window for AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我指出欧洲只有两年窗口期建设 AI 基础设施，企业采用的主要瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能。

kaiser.en: AI progress is smooth exponential, not slowing; pre-training scaling laws persist, but reasoning models yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展是平滑的指数增长，并未放缓；预训练缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型每单位算力带来的收益更大。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期进展；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key challenge beyond reasoning.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的——在某些领域出色，在邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是超越推理的关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans; near-term risks like hacking outweigh existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 当前模型在耗尽表面模式后才学习，不像人类；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools on local computer; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 Claude 需访问用户本地工具才能发挥效用，技能以 markdown 形式实现超个性化自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要，应聚焦能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Biggest gap is not AI capability but people's understanding that almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出最大差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们认知——几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus when unclear; kids excel because they haven't learned what not to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议任务明确用 Sonnet，模糊用 Opus；孩子擅长因未学会不敢问。

felixrieseberg.en: Ideal AI interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch; debug workflow with Claude, not just correct.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，理想 AI 交互是异步：发出任务不盯着；用 Claude 调试流程而非仅纠错。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost, not training cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention has limits.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：数据搬运成本在芯片内部也主导算力成本；脉动阵列减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput is 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：低精度带来二次方效率提升；FP4 吞吐是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain soul and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；简约需保留灵魂与人性。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity must be protected.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟交流无法替代面对面交流对创造性思维的价值；好奇心需被保护，避免被教育扼杀。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for breaking's sake; joy and humor are essential in design.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；愉悦与幽默是设计不可或缺的。

jonyive.en: Design teams must foster trust and care to protect fragile ideas; making for each other is powerful.
jonyive.zh: 设计团队需培养信任与关怀以保护脆弱想法；为彼此而创造更具力量。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a deliberate risk to redefine brand; innovation is essential, tradition is preserving fire, not ashes.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的大胆赌注；创新是设计的本质，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外还有巨大潜力。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problems.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，认为传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题出发。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build fast, ship early, and adapt to AI tools.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年初，宣称设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建、尽早发布并适应 AI 工具。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，主张设计师应成为块状通才或“破解的新人”，而非仅 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and vision are key; speed is not an improvement.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，强调仅凭品味不够，判断力、权威和愿景才是关键；速度并非改进。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools; focus on users.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，认为设计师应掌控 AI 采用节奏，新工具等 6 个月再试，以用户为中心。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍为主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全性是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; open-source can match frontier models with small teams.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；开源小团队可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is key for reasoning; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是推理关键，但存在过度优化风险；开源模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效，但易得收益已尽；增长转向后训练和推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive research for a decade; Chinese labs excel in engineering, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开源模型将驱动未来十年研究；中国实验室擅长工程执行，而非范式创新。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键，但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉的端到端方法在自动驾驶上是正确的。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are like operating systems; vibe coding democratizes programming, but agents need a decade of oversight.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如同操作系统；Vibe coding 使编程大众化，但智能体需要十年的人类监督。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs have jagged intelligence and need a small cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵，而非构建动物；LLM 具有锯齿状智能，需要剥离记忆的小型认知核心。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agentic engineering means directing agents, and understanding remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 自去年 12 月起我未再键入代码；智能体式工程意味着指挥智能体，而理解仍是人类的瓶颈。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，且现代工具使其可解释。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，提出世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处前探。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，认为纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling data and compute is key.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，强调自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，扩展数据和算力是关键。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，认为消费车辆将超越机器人出租车；基础设施和数据质量比算法更重要。

askell.en: Early focus on model welfare and philosophical grounding, treating models as entities with moral status despite uncertainty.
askell.zh: 早期关注模型福祉与哲学基础，在不确定性中视模型为具有道德地位的实体。

askell.en: Shift from welfare to character and consciousness, emphasizing transparency and the need for models to exercise judgment beyond explicit rules.
askell.zh: 从福祉转向性格与意识，强调透明度及模型超越显性规则行使判断力的需求。

askell.en: Warns against excessive corrigibility, advocating for balanced model autonomy to ensure sound judgment and avoid poor generalization.
askell.zh: 警示过度可纠正性，主张平衡模型自主性以确保良好判断并避免泛化不良。

askell.en: Consistent thread: treating AI with respect and care, considering long-term human-AI relations and societal impact.
askell.zh: 一贯主线：尊重与关怀 AI，考虑长期人机关系及社会影响。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration and model disagreement improve sample efficiency and cross-robot zero-shot transfer.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：强调超越训练分布的泛化能力，提出基于模型分歧的好奇心驱动探索，提升样本效率并实现跨机器人零样本迁移。

pathak.en: From curiosity-driven exploration to data-driven pretraining: robotics is a data problem, requiring diverse sources and a general-purpose brain.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年的好奇心驱动探索，到 2026 年转向数据驱动的预训练：认为机器人学是数据问题，需利用多种数据源构建通用大脑。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics, unlike software scaling; it demands rigorous testing and cannot be scaled overnight.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：部署是机器人学的主要挑战，不同于软件扩展，需要严格测试，无法一蹴而就。

pathak.en: Pretraining on diverse data (videos, simulation) plus post-training on real-world data is the key recipe for a universal robot brain.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：在多样化数据（视频、仿真）上预训练，再在真实世界数据上后训练，是构建通用机器人大脑的关键配方。

pathak.en: Consistent focus on generalization and data efficiency, evolving from algorithmic curiosity to large-scale data strategies for embodied AI.
pathak.zh: 始终关注泛化与数据效率，从算法层面的好奇心机制演进到面向具身智能的大规模数据策略。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，缩放推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and governance design are essential early on.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署和治理设计需早期进行。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，认为通过缩放预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心，思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism grows.
